name: CWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The CWA World Heavyweight title as the CWA Originals’ own page lists it, from Yuri Jolnecov in January 1984 to Noah Skanes’s eighth reign, dated May 2009 and still running. Its list runs through 2003 to 2005 with different holders from the CWA World belt of those years in the other CWA wing: the two histories cannot both be the same belt.

name: CWA Inter-Continental Championship
epitaph: The Inter-Continental title as the same page lists it, from Shannon Skanes in January 1984 to Adam Eagle, who holds it from October 2009.

name: CWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The tag titles as the same page lists them, from the Glory Boys in January 1984 to Team SOB’s run dated August 2009 and still running.

name: CWA Diva Championship
epitaph: A Diva title created on its Battle of the Warriors 2007 CWA Edition, 13 January 2007, where Corina wins the sixteen-woman Diva Gauntlet to be its first champion; she shares it with Kelly Buchanan after a ladder match on 3 February and defends it alone on 17 February 2007.

name: CWA Women’s Championship
epitaph: The CWA Women’s title on its Originals cards: Myst defends it at Battle of the Warriors 2007 and vacates it at the end of January 2007, and Sammy Jo Johnson wins it in a five-woman elimination match on 10 February 2007.
